blocks.text: The User Logs Diagnostics page provides user logs and diagnostics data for your VPN connection. The logs can help you troubleshoot issues.
The User Logs Diagnostics page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View, monitor, and analyze VPN user log data in your organization.
Take appropriate actions based on the user log data displayed.

blocks.heading: About the User Logs Diagnostics Page

blocks.text: On the VPN Diagnostics page (Private Access > VPN (for Legacy Apps) > VPN Diagnostics), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter the data displayed by a time range, or use a custom time range.
Refresh the page to reflect the most current information.
View the number of Total, Successful, Errors, and Others transactions for users' VPN connections.
Show or hide the filter options.
Apply filters to the data displayed. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Expand all rows of the table to view more details.
View a list of all user logs for your organization. For each log, you can see:
Event Type: The type of VPN session event for the user.
Event Timestamp: The day and time when the user initiated the VPN session.
Connection Start: The day and time when the VPN session started.
Connection End: The day and time when the VPN session ended. This field is blank if the VPN connection is ongoing.
Client Name: The email address of the client who initiated the VPN session.
Result: The result of the VPN session (Success or Error).
Client Tunnel IP: The IP address of the tunnel through which the user's traffic is forwarded.
VPN Service Edge: The name of the VPN Service Edge that received the request.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Expand an individual user log to view its details:
User Log Details
Client Hostname: The name of the client device.
Client Version: The Zscaler Client Connector version running on the user's device.
Client Public IP: The public IP address of the user's device.
Last Handshake: The date and time of the last TCP handshake.
Client Location: The user's location from where the request was sent.
ZPA Service Edge: The Private Access Service Edge for the connection.
Client Local IP: The local IP address of the user's device.
VPN Service Edge Region: The region for the VPN Service Edge that the user's device connected to for the session.
Failure Reason: The reason for VPN connection failure, if failed.
VPN Service Edge IP: The IP address of the VPN Service Edge that carried the traffic.
Connection ID: The unique ID assigned to identify the connection.
Log Details: View, download, or copy the log details for troubleshooting.
View the user logs in JSON format.

Download the user logs as a text file.
Copy the user logs.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Select another diagnostics page to view:
Traffic Flow Logs: View traffic flow logs for your VPN connections.
Access Policy Data: View diagnostic data for VPN access policies.
